_about: Positions for places the OpenStreetMap search could not find. Each is the coordinate on the place's English Wikipedia article (the article title is given). tools/make_map.py uses these when the search found nothing or found the wrong place.

observatory.source: OpenStreetMap: Observatory Park, in the suburb (the search matched an observatory far away)

lanseria.source: Wikipedia: Lanseria International Airport (the area is named after it)
